why: Neither owed pair changes how the source is translated. hashimoto-2015-toba-shima-geino-7 keeps its translation of 「その費用も村全体で負担し」 word for word; quote-check, which reads the thesis around the quote, added only a bracketed editorial gloss naming what その費用 refers to, and the page's sentence ('paid for their festival plays out of the village purse') already depends on that reading. qingbai-leichao-xiju-3 still gives the unit 金 with round 1's gloss ('gold', money reckoned in taels of silver), which was round 1's real point; only the romanization 'jin' is gone, because record-format found it clashes with the glossary's jin (the catty, a weight). Both earlier rounds came back FAITHFUL overall with two to six LOOSE pairs each, every one a small wording fix that was applied and still holds, and the two owed changes came from other checks' cosmetic edits, not from translation errors. So a third round would be re-checking brackets and the form of a gloss, not the translation.
